The main takeaway from our work is that
the minimal machinery for promoter melting is a very small fraction of the holoenzyme and that this small machinery is sufficient for melting extended DNA.
the minimal machinery for promoter melting is surprisingly simple and is likely to be conserved in other RNAPs.
